\section{{Introduction}}\label{chap:introduction}
translated_text:
\clearpage\setcounter{section}{0}
\section{{引言}}\label{chap:introduction}

source_text: {The finite element exterior calculus, or FEEC, is a theoretical approach to the design and understanding of finite element methods for the numerical solution of a variety of partial differential equations. The finite element method itself is one of the most important technologies of computational science and engineering. A major contributor to its success is the mathematical framework which has been developed over the past 50 years, enabling rigorous error analysis and understanding of the properties of different finite element methods and computations. Traditionally, this framework is primarily based upon the language and tools of functional analysis. FEEC brings in additional tools from topology and homological algebra. More specifically, FEEC captures essential structures of de Rham cohomology and Hodge theory at the discrete level and relates the continuous and discrete structures in order to obtain stable and convergent finite element discretizations.}
translated_text: {有限元外微积分, 简称 FEEC, 是设计和理解求解多种偏微分方程数值解的有限元方法的一种理论途径. 有限元方法本身是计算科学与工程中最重要的技术之一. 它的成功在很大程度上得益于过去 50 年间发展起来的数学框架, 这一框架使严格的误差分析以及对不同有限元方法和计算性质的理解成为可能. 传统上, 这一框架主要基于泛函分析的语言和工具. FEEC 又引入了拓扑和同调代数的工具. 更具体地说, FEEC 在离散层次捕捉 de Rham 上同调和 Hodge 理论的本质结构, 并将连续结构与离散结构联系起来, 从而获得稳定且收敛的有限元离散化.}

source_text: {First we set the stage by recalling some of the classical theory of the finite element method. The simplest setting for finite elements is the numerical solution of Dirichlet's problem for the Poisson equation. Given a real-valued function $f$ on a domain $\Omega$ in $\mathbb R^n$, we seek a function $u$ satisfying}
translated_text: {首先回顾有限元方法的一些经典理论, 为后文作准备. 有限元最简单的应用情形是 Poisson 方程 Dirichlet 问题的数值求解. 给定 $\mathbb R^n$ 中区域 $\Omega$ 上的实值函数 $f$, 我们寻求满足下式的函数 $u$:}

source_text:
\[
-\Delta u=f\text{{ in }}\Omega,\qquad u=0\text{{ on }}\partial\Omega.
\]
translated_text:
\[
-\Delta u=f\text{{ 在 }}\Omega,\qquad u=0\text{{ 在 }}\partial\Omega.
\]

source_text: {The finite element method proceeds not from this strong formulation but from a weak formulation of the boundary value problem. The solution $u$ is sought in the Sobolev space $\mathring H^1(\Omega)$ consisting of $L^2(\Omega)$ functions which have their first partial derivatives also in $L^2(\Omega)$ and which vanish on $\partial\Omega$. It is determined by requiring that the equation}
translated_text: {有限元方法并不从这一强表述出发, 而是从该边值问题的弱表述出发. 我们在 Sobolev 空间 $\mathring H^1(\Omega)$ 中寻求解 $u$, 这个空间由一阶偏导数也属于 $L^2(\Omega)$ 且在 $\partial\Omega$ 上为零的 $L^2(\Omega)$ 函数组成. 解由要求下式成立来确定:}

source_text: {hold for all functions $v$ in the test space $\mathring H^1(\Omega)$ (which, in this example, is the same as the trial space in which $u$ is sought). This equation is derived by multiplying the original Poisson equation by the test function $v$ and integrating over the domain $\Omega$ by parts. The weak formulation of the problem is well-posed, meaning that for any $f$ (in $L^2(\Omega)$, or even in the dual Sobolev space $H^{-1}(\Omega)=\mathring H^1(\Omega)'$) there is a unique weak solution $u$ and, moreover, it depends continuously in $H^1$ on $f$ in $L^2$ or $H^{-1}$.}
translated_text: {对检验空间 $\mathring H^1(\Omega)$ 中的所有函数 $v$ 成立 (在本例中, 检验空间与寻求 $u$ 的试探空间相同). 该方程由原 Poisson 方程乘以检验函数 $v$, 再在区域 $\Omega$ 上作分部积分得到. 该问题的弱表述是适定的, 即对任意 $f$ (属于 $L^2(\Omega)$, 甚至属于对偶 Sobolev 空间 $H^{-1}(\Omega)=\mathring H^1(\Omega)'$), 都存在唯一弱解 $u$, 并且作为 $H^1$ 中的元素, 它连续依赖于 $L^2$ 或 $H^{-1}$ 中的 $f$.}

source_text: {To compute an approximate solution $u_h$, we first consider Galerkin methods, a class that includes the finite element methods. A Galerkin method requires that we specify a finite dimensional subspace $V_h$ of $\mathring H^1(\Omega)$ to be used on the discrete level as both trial and test space. Thus we seek the approximate solution $u_h\in V_h$ by requiring that the weak equation \eqref{eq:poisson-weak-form} be satisfied for test functions $v$ belonging to $V_h$:}
translated_text: {为计算近似解 $u_h$, 我们先考虑包含有限元方法在内的 Galerkin 方法. Galerkin 方法要求指定 $\mathring H^1(\Omega)$ 的一个有限维子空间 $V_h$, 在离散层次同时用作试探空间和检验空间. 因此, 我们通过要求弱方程 \eqref{eq:poisson-weak-form} 对属于 $V_h$ 的检验函数 $v$ 成立, 来寻求近似解 $u_h\in V_h$:}

source_text: {This is a finite dimensional linear system of equations with dimension equal to $\dim V_h$. To compute its solution, we need to specify a basis $\phi_i$ of $V_h$ and to compute the stiffness matrix with entries $\int_\Omega\operatorname{grad}\phi_j\cdot\operatorname{grad}\phi_i\,dx$ and the load vector with entries $\int_\Omega f\phi_i\,dx$, and then to solve the resulting matrix equation, whose solution gives the coefficients of $u_h$ in the selected basis. The stiffness matrix is, in this simple case, symmetric and positive definite, and thus the approximate solution is uniquely determined. Note that the cost of computing the Galerkin solution consists of the cost of computing the stiffness matrix and load vector entries for each basis element, and the cost of solving the resulting linear system of equations.}
translated_text: {这是一个维数等于 $\dim V_h$ 的有限维线性方程组. 为计算其解, 需要指定 $V_h$ 的一组基 $\phi_i$, 计算以 $\int_\Omega\operatorname{grad}\phi_j\cdot\operatorname{grad}\phi_i\,dx$ 为元素的刚度矩阵和以 $\int_\Omega f\phi_i\,dx$ 为元素的载荷向量, 然后求解所得矩阵方程; 其解给出 $u_h$ 在所选基下的系数. 在这个简单情形下, 刚度矩阵对称正定, 因而近似解唯一确定. 注意, 计算 Galerkin 解的代价由两部分组成: 计算每个基元素对应的刚度矩阵和载荷向量元素的代价, 以及求解所得线性方程组的代价.}

source_text: {The solution of the Galerkin method not only is uniquely determined and computable, but is also easy to derive an error estimate for it. In the present case, we may simply invoke Poincaré's inequality}
translated_text: {Galerkin 方法的解不仅唯一确定且可计算, 而且其误差估计也容易导出. 在当前情形下, 只需调用 Poincaré 不等式}

source_text:
\[
\|w\|_{H^1}\le c\|\operatorname{grad}w\|_{L^2},\qquad w\in\mathring H^1,
\]
translated_text:
\[
\|w\|_{H^1}\le c\|\operatorname{grad}w\|_{L^2},\qquad w\in\mathring H^1,
\]

source_text: {where the constant $c$ depends only on the domain $\Omega$. It follows that the bilinear form on the left-hand side of \eqref{eq:poisson-weak-form} defines an inner product on $\mathring H^1$ which is norm equivalent to the $H^1$ inner product and so we may apply the Hilbert projection theorem to prove the solution is quasi-optimal in the $H^1$ norm:}
translated_text: {其中常数 $c$ 只依赖于区域 $\Omega$. 因而 \eqref{eq:poisson-weak-form} 左端的双线性型在 $\mathring H^1$ 上定义一个内积, 其范数与 $H^1$ 内积所对应的范数等价. 因此, 可以应用 Hilbert 投影定理证明该解在 $H^1$ 范数下拟最优:}

source_text: {with the same constant $c$, independent of $f$, $u$, and the choice of subspace $V_h$.}
translated_text: {其中的常数仍为同一个 $c$, 与 $f$、$u$ 以及子空间 $V_h$ 的选择无关.}

source_text: {A finite element method is a Galerkin method for which the Galerkin subspace $V_h$ is a piecewise polynomial space which is efficiently computable (more precisely, it can be constructed through the assembly procedure recalled at the beginning of Section~\ref{sec:complete-polynomial-forms}). The simplest finite elements are the Lagrange piecewise linears. In two dimensions the finite element space is obtained by triangulating the domain $\Omega$ (so the domain is assumed to be a polygon, or approximated by one) and taking $V_h$ to consist of all continuous functions which are polynomial of degree at most 1 on each triangle of the triangulation and which vanish on $\partial\Omega$. Figure~\ref{fig:annular-lagrange-basis} shows the domain $\Omega=(0,3)\times(0,3)\setminus[2/3,2]\times[3/4,2]$ partitioned by a rather coarse triangulation of 256 triangles. In the center of the figure is an example of a piecewise linear function satisfying the Dirichlet boundary conditions.}
translated_text: {有限元方法是一种 Galerkin 方法, 其中的 Galerkin 子空间 $V_h$ 是可高效计算的分片多项式空间 (更准确地说, 它可以通过 Section~\ref{sec:complete-polynomial-forms} 开头回顾的组装过程构造). 最简单的有限元是 Lagrange 分片线性元. 在二维情形下, 将区域 $\Omega$ 作三角剖分 (因此假设区域是多边形, 或用多边形逼近), 并令 $V_h$ 由在剖分的每个三角形上都是次数至多为 1 的多项式、且在 $\partial\Omega$ 上为零的所有连续函数组成, 就得到有限元空间. Figure~\ref{fig:annular-lagrange-basis} 展示了区域 $\Omega=(0,3)\times(0,3)\setminus[2/3,2]\times[3/4,2]$ 的一个相当粗的三角剖分, 共含 256 个三角形. 图的中间是一个满足 Dirichlet 边界条件的分片线性函数的例子.}

source_text: {This space has dimension equal to the number of interior vertices of the triangulation, and it admits a convenient basis called the Lagrange basis, with each basis function equal to unity at a unique interior vertex and zero at all the others, as illustrated in the right image in the figure. This is a local basis in the sense that each basis function is supported in only a small number of triangles. As a result, the integrals needed for the stiffness matrix and load vector can be computed very quickly, and the stiffness matrix is highly sparse (having only seven nonzero elements per row on average, asymptotically as the mesh is refined). Thus the finite element solution is efficiently computable. By \eqref{eq:galerkin-quasioptimality} its accuracy in $H^1(\Omega)$ is comparable to the best continuous piecewise linear approximation on the mesh. To improve the accuracy of the finite element solution, we can enrich the finite element space by refining the mesh. Alternatively, we can use Lagrange finite elements of higher degree, i.e., increase the degree of the piecewise polynomials to some $d>1$. Combining the estimate \eqref{eq:galerkin-quasioptimality} with approximation theory we ensure that the error goes to 0 as either the mesh size tends to 0 or the element degree tends to $\infty$.}
translated_text: {这个空间的维数等于三角剖分的内部顶点数, 它有一组方便的基, 称为 Lagrange 基: 每个基函数在唯一一个内部顶点处等于一, 在其余内部顶点处等于零, 如图的右侧所示. 这是一组局部基, 意指每个基函数的支集仅覆盖少数几个三角形. 因而, 刚度矩阵和载荷向量所需的积分可以很快算出, 且刚度矩阵高度稀疏 (当网格加密时, 渐近地每行平均只有七个非零元素). 因此有限元解可高效计算. 由 \eqref{eq:galerkin-quasioptimality}, 它在 $H^1(\Omega)$ 中的精度与该网格上最佳连续分片线性逼近的精度相当. 为提高有限元解的精度, 可以通过加密网格来扩充有限元空间. 也可以使用更高次的 Lagrange 有限元, 即把分片多项式的次数提高到某个 $d>1$. 将估计 \eqref{eq:galerkin-quasioptimality} 与逼近理论结合, 可保证当网格尺寸趋于 0 或单元次数趋于 $\infty$ 时, 误差趋于 0.}

source_text: {We have illustrated the basic aspects of the finite element method on a simple model problem. Such a treatment would generally be continued by establishing rates of convergence and their dependence on the triangulation and the regularity of the solution, proving error estimates in norms other than the $H^1$ norm, developing algorithms for a posteriori error estimation and adaptive meshing and analyzing their performance, and, of course, extensions to other problems. See one of the many available books for such treatments, e.g., \BookCite{21}, \BookCite{22}, \BookCite{31}, \BookCite{40}.}
translated_text: {我们用一个简单的模型问题说明了有限元方法的基本方面. 通常, 接下来会建立收敛阶及其对三角剖分和解正则性的依赖关系, 证明 $H^1$ 范数以外其他范数下的误差估计, 发展后验误差估计和自适应网格算法并分析其性能, 当然还会推广到其他问题. 这方面的论述可参见众多现有著作, 例如 \BookCite{21}、\BookCite{22}、\BookCite{31}、\BookCite{40}.}

source_text: {We will soon discuss a problem for which the standard finite element approach fails, in order to motivate the study of FEEC. However, first, let us continue with the standard finite element method, not for the source problem just discussed but rather for the Laplacian eigenvalue problem. Again, this is a problem for which standard finite elements are very successful and for which the theoretical justification, which relies heavily on spectral theory in Hilbert space, is extensive \BookCite{16}, \BookCite{18}. Retaining the domain of Figure~\ref{fig:annular-lagrange-basis}, we seek the fundamental mode and frequency (or perhaps several modes and frequencies) of an annular polygonal drum. That is, we want to find the least $\lambda\in\mathbb R$ for which there exists nonzero $u:\Omega\to\mathbb R$ such that}
translated_text: {为了说明研究 FEEC 的动机, 我们很快将讨论一个使标准有限元途径失效的问题. 不过, 先继续讨论标准有限元方法, 但不再针对刚才的源问题, 而是针对 Laplacian 特征值问题. 标准有限元对这一问题同样十分成功, 并且有大量理论论证, 其中很大程度上依赖 Hilbert 空间中的谱理论 \BookCite{16}、\BookCite{18}. 仍使用 Figure~\ref{fig:annular-lagrange-basis} 中的区域, 我们寻求一面环状多边形鼓的基模和基频 (也可能是若干振型和频率). 也就是说, 要找到最小的 $\lambda\in\mathbb R$, 使得存在非零 $u:\Omega\to\mathbb R$ 满足}

source_text: {Passing to a weak formulation and applying Galerkin's method brings us to the discrete eigenvalue problem of finding $\lambda_h\in\mathbb R$ and nonzero $u_h\in V_h$ such that}
translated_text: {转为弱表述并应用 Galerkin 方法, 就得到求 $\lambda_h\in\mathbb R$ 和非零 $u_h\in V_h$ 的离散特征值问题, 使得}

source_text:
\[
\int_\Omega\operatorname{grad}u_h\cdot\operatorname{grad}v\,dx=\lambda_h\int_\Omega u_hv\,dx,\qquad v\in V_h.
\]
translated_text:
\[
\int_\Omega\operatorname{grad}u_h\cdot\operatorname{grad}v\,dx=\lambda_h\int_\Omega u_hv\,dx,\qquad v\in V_h.
\]

source_text: {Via a basis, this reduces to a symmetric sparse generalized eigenvalue problem, with one matrix the stiffness matrix defined above and the other the mass matrix defined in a similar way but using the $L^2$ inner product occuring on the right-hand side of the equation. This matrix generalized eigenvalue problem can be efficiently solved by an iterative method, such as the inverse power method to find the fundamental eigenpair, or Krylov–Schur iteration to calculate the portion of the spectrum within some interval. As to theory, one can prove, in this case, that the first eigenfunction $u_h$ satisfies a quasi-optimal error estimate like \eqref{eq:galerkin-quasioptimality} and that the eigenvalue error is bounded by a multiple of the square of eigenfunction error. See, e.g., \BookCite{18} for a lucid exposition, including the case of more than one eigenvalue and the complications arising from eigenvalues which are not simple.}
translated_text: {通过一组基, 这可以化为一个对称稀疏广义特征值问题: 其中一个矩阵是上面定义的刚度矩阵, 另一个是以类似方式、但使用方程右端出现的 $L^2$ 内积定义的质量矩阵. 这一矩阵广义特征值问题可用迭代方法高效求解, 例如用反幂法求基特征对, 或用 Krylov–Schur 迭代计算某个区间内的谱. 在理论方面, 可以证明当前情形下第一个特征函数 $u_h$ 满足形如 \eqref{eq:galerkin-quasioptimality} 的拟最优误差估计, 且特征值误差不超过特征函数误差平方的某个倍数. 清晰的论述可参见例如 \BookCite{18}, 其中也包括多于一个特征值的情形以及非单特征值所引起的复杂情况.}

source_text: {Next we illustrate the performance with some numerical results. For the coarse mesh of 256 triangles shown in Figure~\ref{fig:annular-lagrange-basis}, and Lagrange linear finite elements, the computed value of the fundamental eigenvalue is 9.986 and the computed fundamental eigenfunction is the one plotted in the center of Figure~\ref{fig:annular-lagrange-basis}. It is no surprise that these are not very accurate (the eigenvalue error turns out to be about 9\%), given the coarseness of the mesh. However, we can improve the accuracy to the extent desired by refining the mesh and/or increasing the polynomial degree. In Table~\ref{tab:scalar-laplacian-eigenvalues}, we show the results for polynomials of degree 1 and 3, both for the fundamental eigenvalue and the second eigenvalue, and for a sequence of meshes obtained from the original one by uniform refinement of the initial mesh. With piecewise linears and 65,536 triangles or piecewise cubics and 1,024 triangles we obtain the fundamental eigenvalue to within about 0.1\%. Figure~\ref{fig:scalar-fundamental-mode} shows the fundamental eigenfunction computed with linear Lagrange elements on the mesh with 65,536 triangles. It is worth remarking that the same accuracy as is achieved with these uniformly refined meshes could be obtained with far fewer triangles using adaptive refinement, but that is not a direction we shall discuss in this book.}
translated_text: {接下来用一些数值结果说明其表现. 对 Figure~\ref{fig:annular-lagrange-basis} 中含 256 个三角形的粗网格, 使用 Lagrange 线性有限元算出的基本特征值为 9.986, 所算基特征函数如 Figure~\ref{fig:annular-lagrange-basis} 中间所示. 鉴于网格很粗, 这些结果不太精确并不意外 (特征值误差约为 9\%). 不过, 通过加密网格和/或提高多项式次数, 可以将精度提高到所需程度. Table~\ref{tab:scalar-laplacian-eigenvalues} 给出 1 次和 3 次多项式下基本特征值和第二特征值的结果, 所用的一列网格由初始网格均匀加密得到. 用含 65,536 个三角形的分片线性元, 或含 1,024 个三角形的分片三次元, 基本特征值误差可控制在约 0.1\% 以内. Figure~\ref{fig:scalar-fundamental-mode} 展示了在含 65,536 个三角形的网格上用线性 Lagrange 元计算的基特征函数. 值得指出, 使用自适应加密, 可以用少得多的三角形达到这些均匀加密网格的精度, 不过本书不讨论这一方向.}

source_text: {Now we consider a problem for which the classical approach is insufficient and FEEC comes to the rescue. For this, we move slightly away from the scalar Laplacian. Instead we consider the vector Laplacian, the operator $-\Delta=\operatorname{curl}\operatorname{curl}-\operatorname{grad}\operatorname{div}$ acting on a vector field $u:\Omega\to\mathbb R^2$. (Since we are in two dimensions, $\operatorname{curl}u$ is a scalar function, while the second application of $\operatorname{curl}$ maps the scalar function back to a vector field.) Thus we consider the eigenvalue problem}
translated_text: {现在考虑一个经典途径不足以处理、而 FEEC 能够解决的问题. 为此, 我们稍稍离开标量 Laplacian, 转而考虑向量 Laplacian, 即作用于向量场 $u:\Omega\to\mathbb R^2$ 的算子 $-\Delta=\operatorname{curl}\operatorname{curl}-\operatorname{grad}\operatorname{div}$. (由于处于二维, $\operatorname{curl}u$ 是标量函数, 而第二次应用 $\operatorname{curl}$ 将该标量函数映回向量场.) 因此考虑特征值问题}

source_text: {These boundary conditions, sometimes called magnetic for their application in electromagnetism, allow for a simple weak formulation. Define the space $\mathring H(\operatorname{div})$ consisting of vector fields in $L^2$ with divergence in $L^2$ and for which $u\cdot n$ vanishes on the boundary, and also the space $H(\operatorname{curl})$ of $L^2$ vector fields with curl in $L^2$ (with no boundary conditions imposed). If we take an arbitrary test vector field $v\in\mathring H(\operatorname{div})\cap H(\operatorname{curl})$ and compute its $L^2$ inner product with the vector fields on both sides of \eqref{eq:vector-laplacian-eigenproblem}, we get, after integration by parts, that}
translated_text: {这些边界条件因其在电磁学中的应用, 有时称为磁边界条件, 它们允许一种简单的弱表述. 定义空间 $\mathring H(\operatorname{div})$, 由散度属于 $L^2$ 且在边界上 $u\cdot n$ 为零的 $L^2$ 向量场组成; 再定义空间 $H(\operatorname{curl})$, 由旋度属于 $L^2$ 的 $L^2$ 向量场组成 (不施加边界条件). 取任意检验向量场 $v\in\mathring H(\operatorname{div})\cap H(\operatorname{curl})$, 计算它与 \eqref{eq:vector-laplacian-eigenproblem} 两端向量场的 $L^2$ 内积, 分部积分后得到}

source_text: {where no boundary integral term arises from the integration by parts of the curl since $\operatorname{curl}u=0$ on the boundary, and none arises in the integration by parts of the gradient since $v\cdot n=0$. Thus, we obtain a weak formulation of \eqref{eq:vector-laplacian-eigenproblem} by seeking $u\in\mathring H(\operatorname{div})\cap H(\operatorname{curl})$ satisfying \eqref{eq:vector-laplacian-primal-form} for all $v$ belonging to the same space. Note that the boundary condition on $u\cdot n$ is essential in this formulation---it is imposed on the space in which the solution is sought---while the boundary condition on $\operatorname{curl}u$ is natural, arising from the weak formulation.}
translated_text: {其中, 因为边界上 $\operatorname{curl}u=0$, 对旋度作分部积分不产生边界积分项; 因为 $v\cdot n=0$, 对梯度作分部积分也不产生边界积分项. 因此, 通过寻求 $u\in\mathring H(\operatorname{div})\cap H(\operatorname{curl})$, 使 \eqref{eq:vector-laplacian-primal-form} 对同一空间中的所有 $v$ 成立, 我们得到 \eqref{eq:vector-laplacian-eigenproblem} 的弱表述. 注意, 在该表述中, 关于 $u\cdot n$ 的边界条件是本质边界条件, 它施加在寻求解的空间上; 而关于 $\operatorname{curl}u$ 的边界条件是自然边界条件, 由弱表述产生.}

source_text: {If we naively attempt to compute the eigenvalues using a method analogous to that which we used for the scalar Laplacian, we are in for a big disappointment. To illustrate this, we discretize the weak formulation \eqref{eq:vector-laplacian-primal-form} using Galerkin's method, taking as the Galerkin subspace the space of vector fields both of whose components are continuous piecewise linear polynomials (or piecewise polynomials of higher degree: vector Lagrange elements of degree $d$). The results are reported in Table~\ref{tab:vector-lagrange-wrong-eigenvalues}, which is altogether analogous to Table~\ref{tab:scalar-laplacian-eigenvalues}, except that it pertains to the vector Laplacian eigenvalue problem \eqref{eq:vector-laplacian-eigenproblem} instead of to the scalar Laplacian eigenvalue problem \eqref{eq:scalar-laplacian-eigenproblem}. The computed eigenvalues tabulated in Table~\ref{tab:vector-lagrange-wrong-eigenvalues} appear to be converging. For example, the computations strongly suggest that the fundamental eigenvalue is about 1.8. \textbf{But this is entirely wrong!} As we shall see later in the book, the vector Laplacian on a plane domain with the given boundary conditions has a kernel whose dimension is the first Betti number of the domain: the number of holes. Therefore, for our problem the Laplacian has a one-dimensional kernel and the first eigenvalue is precisely 0. The convergence of the finite element computation with the Lagrange elements to 1.8 is entirely misleading. The situation is no better for the second eigenvalue either. The Lagrange finite element computation converges to a value of around 1.86, but in fact the correct value is totally different, namely, 0.617.}
translated_text: {如果直接尝试用类似于标量 Laplacian 情形的方法计算这些特征值, 结果会令人大失所望. 为说明这一点, 用 Galerkin 方法离散弱表述 \eqref{eq:vector-laplacian-primal-form}, 取两个分量均为连续分片线性多项式的向量场空间作为 Galerkin 子空间 (也可以是更高次分片多项式: $d$ 次向量 Lagrange 元). 结果列于 Table~\ref{tab:vector-lagrange-wrong-eigenvalues}. 该表与 Table~\ref{tab:scalar-laplacian-eigenvalues} 完全类似, 只是针对向量 Laplacian 特征值问题 \eqref{eq:vector-laplacian-eigenproblem}, 而非标量 Laplacian 特征值问题 \eqref{eq:scalar-laplacian-eigenproblem}. Table~\ref{tab:vector-lagrange-wrong-eigenvalues} 所列的计算特征值看起来正在收敛. 例如, 计算强烈暗示基本特征值约为 1.8. \textbf{但这完全错误!} 正如我们将在本书后面看到的, 在给定边界条件下, 平面区域上的向量 Laplacian 的核的维数是该区域的第一 Betti 数, 即洞的数量. 因此, 对本问题, Laplacian 有一维核, 第一个特征值恰为 0. 使用 Lagrange 元的有限元计算收敛到 1.8, 完全具有误导性. 第二个特征值的情况也没有更好. Lagrange 有限元计算收敛到约 1.86, 但正确值实际上截然不同, 为 0.617.}

source_text: {The abject failure of the basic finite element method for the vector Laplacian eigenvalue problem can be remedied with FEEC. A FEEC approach to this problem uses a weak formulation which is different from \eqref{eq:vector-laplacian-primal-form} and discretizes it not with Lagrange finite elements but with specially designed finite elements. The results of the FEEC approach are shown in Table~\ref{tab:feec-vector-eigenvalues}. Notice that the FEEC methods compute the fundamental eigenvalue of 0 exactly (except for roundoff error). As mentioned, this eigenvalue reflects a fundamental topological structure of the problem---the hole in the domain. This is a first example of FEEC methods being structure-preserving. In topological terms, they preserve the homology of the domain. The FEEC methods are not exact for the next eigenvalue, of course, but they do converge to it nicely. In Figure~\ref{fig:feec-vector-eigenfunctions}, we show the first two eigenfunctions computed with the lowest order FEEC method on the mesh with 4,096 triangles. Notice that the first eigenfunction is a vector field which swirls around the hole in the domain. Both eigenfunctions have strong singularities at the reentrant corners.}
translated_text: {基本有限元方法在向量 Laplacian 特征值问题上的彻底失效可以用 FEEC 补救. 针对该问题的 FEEC 途径采用不同于 \eqref{eq:vector-laplacian-primal-form} 的弱表述, 并用专门设计的有限元而非 Lagrange 有限元离散它. FEEC 途径的结果见 Table~\ref{tab:feec-vector-eigenvalues}. 注意, FEEC 方法精确算出了值为 0 的基本特征值 (舍入误差除外). 如前所述, 这一特征值反映问题的一项基本拓扑结构, 即区域中的洞. 这是 FEEC 方法保结构性质的第一个例子. 用拓扑术语说, 这些方法保留区域的同调. 当然, FEEC 方法对下一个特征值并非精确, 但它们确实很好地向该值收敛. Figure~\ref{fig:feec-vector-eigenfunctions} 展示了在含 4,096 个三角形的网格上用最低阶 FEEC 方法计算的前两个特征函数. 注意, 第一个特征函数是绕区域中的洞旋转的向量场. 两个特征函数在凹角处都有强奇性.}

source_text: {The reader may have noticed several features of this example. It is an eigenvalue problem rather than a source problem. The domain has both a hole, which is tied to the existence of the zero eigenvalue, and a reentrant corner, which gives rise to a singular solution. The singularity is in fact quite strong: the magnitude of the eigenfunction itself, and not just of its derivatives, grows unboundedly as we approach one of the reentrant corners. The last point is the most crucial for the failure of the standard finite element method based on the weak formulation \eqref{eq:vector-laplacian-primal-form}.}
translated_text: {读者可能已经注意到这个例子的几个特点. 它是特征值问题, 而不是源问题. 区域既有与零特征值的存在相联系的洞, 也有导致奇异解的凹角. 这种奇性实际上相当强: 当我们接近某个凹角时, 无界增长的是特征函数本身的大小, 而不仅仅是它的导数. 最后这一点是基于弱表述 \eqref{eq:vector-laplacian-primal-form} 的标准有限元方法失效的最关键原因.}

source_text: {We shall return to this point in Section~\ref{sec:primal-galerkin} and fully explain the failure. There we will also give another example, a source problem on a simply connected domain with a reentrant corner, and see that the standard finite element method fails for it as well. (The interested reader may peek ahead to Figure~\ref{fig:primal-lagrange-failure} to see.) Then, in Section~\ref{sec:mixed-methods} we will show that these problems fit within the FEEC framework of analysis developed in the first part of the book, and so the convergence of the FEEC approach for them is guaranteed.}
translated_text: {我们将在 Section~\ref{sec:primal-galerkin} 回到这一点, 完整解释这种失效. 那里还将给出另一个例子, 即带凹角的单连通区域上的源问题, 并看到标准有限元方法对它同样失效. (感兴趣的读者可以先看 Figure~\ref{fig:primal-lagrange-failure}.) 随后, Section~\ref{sec:mixed-methods} 将表明这些问题适用于本书第一部分建立的 FEEC 分析框架, 因而 FEEC 途径对它们的收敛性得到保证.}

source_text: {At the conclusion of Section~\ref{sec:primal-galerkin} we also give a third, quite different, example of failure of the standard finite element method for a vector Laplace source problem. In that case the domain is a circular annulus and so has a smooth boundary and a smooth solution up to the boundary. The failure must therefore have a different origin, not dependent on singularity. Indeed, it turns out to be related to the zero eigenvalue, as we shall explain there.}
translated_text: {在 Section~\ref{sec:primal-galerkin} 结尾, 我们还给出第三个颇为不同的例子, 展示标准有限元方法在向量 Laplace 源问题上的失效. 在那个例子中, 区域是圆环, 因而边界光滑, 解也直到边界都光滑. 因此, 失效必有不依赖奇性的不同原因. 事实上, 它与零特征值有关, 我们将在那里作出解释.}

source_text: {Another popular class of examples for demonstrating the pitfalls of naive finite element methods and the need for methods based on the formulations and finite element spaces we develop in this book involves neither holes in the domain nor singular behavior. A simple example is the Maxwell eigenvalue problem, which in its simplest form is the eigenvalue problem for the curl curl operator,}
translated_text: {还有一类常用例子, 用来说明直接套用有限元方法的陷阱, 以及采用基于本书所建立表述和有限元空间的方法的必要性; 这类例子既不涉及区域中的洞, 也不涉及奇异行为. 一个简单的例子是 Maxwell 特征值问题, 其最简单的形式就是 curl curl 算子的特征值问题:}

source_text:
\[
\operatorname{curl}\operatorname{curl}u=\lambda u,
\]
translated_text:
\[
\operatorname{curl}\operatorname{curl}u=\lambda u,
\]

source_text: {together with, say, the electric boundary condition $u\times n=0$. The eigenvalues $\lambda$ for this problem are all real and nonnegative. However, for a simply connected domain, the only eigenpairs which are of interest are those for which $\lambda>0$, since for these the equation implies that $\operatorname{div}u=0$, which is a requirement of Maxwell's equations. There exists also an infinite dimensional space of eigenvectors for the eigenvalue $\lambda=0$, comprising gradients of smooth functions which vanish on the boundary. However, we do not consider 0 to be a Maxwell eigenvalue, since these gradient eigenfunctions are not divergence-free. (In case the domain is not simply connected there is also be a finite dimensional space of divergence-free 0 eigenvectors.)}
translated_text: {并配以例如电边界条件 $u\times n=0$. 这一问题的特征值 $\lambda$ 都是实数且非负. 不过, 对单连通区域, 只有 $\lambda>0$ 的特征对才是我们关心的, 因为此时方程蕴含 $\operatorname{div}u=0$, 这是 Maxwell 方程的一个要求. 特征值 $\lambda=0$ 也对应一个无限维特征向量空间, 由在边界上为零的光滑函数的梯度组成. 但是, 我们不把 0 视为 Maxwell 特征值, 因为这些梯度特征函数并非无散的. (若区域不是单连通的, 则还存在一个由无散的 0 特征向量组成的有限维空间.)}

source_text: {We will consider the Maxwell eigenvalue problem on a square domain $\Omega=(0,\pi)\times(0,\pi)$. In this case, the exact eigenpairs have a simple analytic expression which can be computed by separation of variables. The eigenvectors are}
translated_text: {我们将考虑正方形区域 $\Omega=(0,\pi)\times(0,\pi)$ 上的 Maxwell 特征值问题. 此时, 精确特征对具有简单的解析表达式, 可通过分离变量法计算. 特征向量为}

source_text:
\[
u(x,y)=\operatorname{curl}(\sin mx\sin ny)=(n\sin mx\cos ny,-m\cos mx\sin ny),
\]
translated_text:
\[
u(x,y)=\operatorname{curl}(\sin mx\sin ny)=(n\sin mx\cos ny,-m\cos mx\sin ny),
\]

source_text: {where $m$ and $n$ are nonnegative integers, not both zero, and the corresponding eigenvalues $\lambda=m^2+n^2$, i.e.,}
translated_text: {其中 $m$ 和 $n$ 是不同时为零的非负整数, 对应的特征值为 $\lambda=m^2+n^2$, 即}

source_text: {A weak formulation of the eigenvalue problem seeks nonzero $u\in\mathring H(\operatorname{curl})$ and $\lambda>0$ such that}
translated_text: {该特征值问题的一种弱表述是寻求非零 $u\in\mathring H(\operatorname{curl})$ 和 $\lambda>0$, 使得}

source_text:
\[
\int_\Omega\operatorname{curl}u\operatorname{curl}v\,dx=\lambda\int_\Omega u\cdot v\,dx,\qquad v\in\mathring H(\operatorname{curl}),
\]
translated_text:
\[
\int_\Omega\operatorname{curl}u\operatorname{curl}v\,dx=\lambda\int_\Omega u\cdot v\,dx,\qquad v\in\mathring H(\operatorname{curl}),
\]

source_text: {where the space $\mathring H(\operatorname{curl})$ incorporates the boundary condition $u\times n=0$. We now show the results of discretizing this formulation using Galerkin's method. For the Galerkin finite element method we investigate two different sorts of uniform triangulations and, for each of these, two different finite element spaces. The first mesh we use is of diagonal type, obtained by dividing the square into $40\times40$ subsquares and dividing each of them into two triangles using the positively sloped diagonal, and the second is of crisscross type, with each subsquare divided into four triangles using both diagonals. Meshes of the two types are shown in Figure~\ref{fig:diagonal-crisscross-meshes}, but with only $10\times10$ subsquares for improved visibility.}
translated_text: {其中空间 $\mathring H(\operatorname{curl})$ 包含边界条件 $u\times n=0$. 现在展示用 Galerkin 方法离散这一表述的结果. 对 Galerkin 有限元方法, 我们考察两类不同的均匀三角剖分, 并在每一类上考察两个不同的有限元空间. 第一类为对角型网格: 将正方形分成 $40\times40$ 个小正方形, 再用正斜率对角线将每个小正方形分成两个三角形. 第二类为交叉型网格: 用两条对角线将每个小正方形分成四个三角形. Figure~\ref{fig:diagonal-crisscross-meshes} 展示了两类网格, 但为便于观察, 只使用 $10\times10$ 个小正方形.}

source_text: {For the finite element spaces, we compare two possibilities on each mesh: the simple vector Lagrange elements of degree 1 (continuous piecewise linear vector fields fulfilling the boundary conditions) and elements fitting the FEEC framework, the so-called Nédélec edge elements of lowest degree. In each case, we had the Krylov–Schur eigenvalue solver report the 12 eigenvalues nearest 5.5. The results are shown in Table~\ref{tab:maxwell-spectral-comparison}. Comparing the exact eigenvalues to the ones computed with Lagrange elements on the diagonal mesh, we see \emph{complete failure}: the eigenvalues are nowhere near the correct ones. On the crisscross mesh, we have failure again, but it is more subtle (and arguably more dangerous). In fact, 11 of the first 12 eigenvalues are accurately computed, but the eighth computed eigenvalue is 6.00. This value is \emph{completely spurious}: the correct value is 8. Had we computed more than 12 eigenvalues, we would have found additional spurious eigenvalues, the next being a spurious double eigenvalue around 15. Moreover, when a finer crisscross mesh is used, these spurious values persist (and apparently converge to the precise, but spurious, values 6 and 15). By contrast, the FEEC method converges nicely for both meshes, a fact that can be backed by theory. We will return to this example in Section~\ref{sec:eigenvalue-problems}.}
translated_text: {对于有限元空间, 在每种网格上比较两种选择: 简单的 1 次向量 Lagrange 元 (满足边界条件的连续分片线性向量场), 以及适用于 FEEC 框架的、所谓最低次 Nédélec 棱元. 每种情形都让 Krylov–Schur 特征值求解器给出最接近 5.5 的 12 个特征值. 结果见 Table~\ref{tab:maxwell-spectral-comparison}. 将精确特征值与对角型网格上使用 Lagrange 元计算的特征值比较, 可见\emph{完全失效}: 所算特征值与正确值相去甚远. 在交叉型网格上同样失效, 只是更加隐蔽 (也可以说更加危险). 事实上, 前 12 个特征值中有 11 个算得准确, 但算出的第八个特征值为 6.00. 这一值\emph{完全是伪值}: 正确值为 8. 如果计算多于 12 个特征值, 就会发现其他伪特征值, 下一个是在 15 附近的伪二重特征值. 而且, 改用更细的交叉型网格时, 这些伪值仍然存在 (并且看起来收敛到精确但虚假的数值 6 和 15). 相比之下, FEEC 方法在两种网格上都很好地收敛, 这一事实可以得到理论支持. 我们将在 Section~\ref{sec:eigenvalue-problems} 回到这个例子.}

source_text: {Having surveyed some motivating examples, we conclude the introduction with a description of the remainder of the book. In the first part of this exposition, in Chapters~\ref{chap:homological-algebra}--\ref{chap:approximation-hilbert-complexes}, we develop the basic abstract framework and results of FEEC. The key structure of this framework is a Hilbert complex. A Hilbert complex arises from the marriage of the algebraic structure of a chain complex, as studied in homological algebra, with the analytic setting of unbounded operators on Hilbert spaces from functional analysis. In Chapter~\ref{chap:homological-algebra} we provide an elementary self-contained introduction to the few results we need from homological algebra, and in Chapter~\ref{chap:unbounded-operators} we introduce the basic results we need concerning unbounded operators on Hilbert space. These two chapters establish material which is prerequisite to what follows. Both of these, and subsequent chapters, end with a box summarizing the main results obtained in the chapter. Readers familiar with the subject of the chapter can skip forward to the boxed summary at the end and decide whether it is necessary to read the body of the chapter. After the first two prerequisite chapters, we develop Hilbert complexes in Chapter~\ref{chap:hilbert-complexes}. Throughout, we illustrate the abstract concepts with the important and canonical example of the $L^2$ de Rham complex on a domain in three-dimensional Euclidean space. Each Hilbert complex gives rise to a sequence of operator equations, which are the abstract generalizations of scalar and vector Poisson equations in the case of the three-dimensional de Rham complex, as well as other elliptic partial differential equations. The accurate numerical solution of these problems is the goal of FEEC. The approximation of these so-called abstract Hodge Laplacian problems is studied within the Hilbert complex framework in Chapter~\ref{chap:approximation-hilbert-complexes}, where the main theoretical results of FEEC are established. In particular, we show that consistent, stable, and so convergent approximations are obtained by Galerkin's method applied to a mixed formulation of the equations as long as the Galerkin subspaces satisfy a few important hypotheses.}
translated_text: {介绍了若干说明动机的例子之后, 我们以本书其余部分的安排结束引言. 在本书第一部分, 即 Chapters~\ref{chap:homological-algebra}--\ref{chap:approximation-hilbert-complexes}, 建立 FEEC 的基本抽象框架和结果. 该框架的关键结构是 Hilbert 复形. Hilbert 复形将同调代数所研究的链复形的代数结构, 与泛函分析中 Hilbert 空间上无界算子的分析背景结合起来. Chapter~\ref{chap:homological-algebra} 以初等且自包含的方式介绍我们所需的少量同调代数结果; Chapter~\ref{chap:unbounded-operators} 则介绍所需的 Hilbert 空间上无界算子的基本结果. 这两章建立后文所需的预备知识. 这两章及后续各章均以一个框结束, 总结该章所得主要结果. 熟悉该章主题的读者可以先跳到章末的框内总结, 再决定是否需要阅读正文. 两章预备知识之后, Chapter~\ref{chap:hilbert-complexes} 展开 Hilbert 复形的理论. 全书始终以三维 Euclidean 空间中区域上的 $L^2$ de Rham 复形这一重要而典型的例子来说明抽象概念. 每个 Hilbert 复形产生一列算子方程; 在三维 de Rham 复形的情形下, 它们是标量和向量 Poisson 方程以及其他椭圆偏微分方程的抽象推广. 精确地数值求解这些问题是 FEEC 的目标. Chapter~\ref{chap:approximation-hilbert-complexes} 在 Hilbert 复形框架内研究这些所谓抽象 Hodge Laplacian 问题的逼近, 并建立 FEEC 的主要理论结果. 特别地, 我们将说明, 只要 Galerkin 子空间满足若干重要假设, 对方程的混合表述应用 Galerkin 方法就能得到相容、稳定, 因而收敛的逼近.}

source_text: {In the second part of the book, Chapters~\ref{chap:exterior-calculus} and~\ref{chap:finite-element-differential-forms}, we specialize from a general Hilbert complex to the $L^2$ de Rham complex on an $n$-dimensional domain or Riemannian manifold. In this case, the spaces are not abstract Hilbert spaces but rather Hilbert spaces of differential forms. To treat this case, we introduce the language and basic results of exterior calculus in Chapter~\ref{chap:exterior-calculus}, which allows for a unified and more insightful treatment of all the spaces and operators involved. Our next task is then to define, in the concrete setting of the de Rham complex, Galerkin subspaces of differential forms. This is the main task of Chapter~\ref{chap:finite-element-differential-forms}.}
translated_text: {在本书第二部分, 即 Chapters~\ref{chap:exterior-calculus} 和~\ref{chap:finite-element-differential-forms}, 我们从一般 Hilbert 复形转向 $n$ 维区域或 Riemannian 流形上的 $L^2$ de Rham 复形这一特例. 此时, 各空间不是抽象 Hilbert 空间, 而是微分形式的 Hilbert 空间. 为处理这一情形, Chapter~\ref{chap:exterior-calculus} 介绍外微积分的语言和基本结果, 从而能够对所涉及的所有空间和算子作统一且更有洞见的处理. 随后的任务是在 de Rham 复形的具体背景中定义微分形式的 Galerkin 子空间. 这是 Chapter~\ref{chap:finite-element-differential-forms} 的主要任务.}

source_text: {Finally, in the concluding chapter of the book we give a glimpse of extensions and applications that take us beyond the de Rham complex and to additional applications.}
translated_text: {最后, 本书结尾一章简要展示一些推广和应用, 使我们超越 de Rham 复形, 进入更多应用领域.}
